title: Ledger audit: corrections applied rigorously with sources
method: re-read every script+JSON claim touching alpha_cusp, the escape threshold, and the direction counts; verified each against the code's own MC/closed forms; corrected scripts, regenerated JSONs, and recorded every change here.  Key reconciliation: the escape rule I*h/X > g0*gdepth*d* (=0.1266) is equivalent to h/X > theta_star = g0*gdepth*d*/I = 0.0633, and theta_star = g0*gdepth*alpha_cusp where alpha_cusp = (g*-g0)/(I*g0*gdepth) = d*/I = 1.0553 is a DIMENSIONLESS g-axis marker at the phase cusp g*, not an h/X threshold.

corrections.wrong_statement: escape iff I*h/X > g0*gdepth*d*, i.e. h/X > alpha_cusp = 1.05529
corrections.correct_fact: escape iff I*h/X > g0*gdepth*d* (=0.1266), i.e. h/X > theta_star = g0*gdepth*d*/I = 0.0633; alpha_cusp is the g-ladder coordinate at g* (d*/I), NOT the threshold
corrections.fix: renamed marker field to alpha_cusp_g_star_marker; added escape_threshold_h_over_X=0.0633; docstring/print corrected with a CORRECTION note
corrections.verified: MC rule unchanged => mc_escape=0.8305 (harm_cap MC benchmark intact); printed theta_star=0.06332

corrections.wrong_statement: escape the rotation iff I*h/X > g0*gdepth*d* =: alpha_cusp (1.0553)
corrections.correct_fact: I*h/X > g0*gdepth*d* = 0.1266 (threshold h/X > 0.0633); alpha_cusp = d*/I = 1.0553 is the g-ladder marker at g*
corrections.fix: corrected text; NEW result: f(s) = S(theta_star/s), the EXACT closed-form survival of the threat ratio (genesis_tail law), verified row-by-row against MC
corrections.verified: all 9 grid rows match S(theta*/s) to |resid|<=0.0014 (MC noise); midpoint ~0.5 consistent with S(theta*/s*)=0.5; calibrated s=1.0: MC 0.8306 vs closed form 0.8300

corrections.wrong_statement: field key 'alpha_cusp_escape_h_over_X' = 1.0553; docstring 'the escape threshold alpha_cusp'
corrections.correct_fact: alpha_cusp (d*/I) is the g-ladder marker at g*; escape threshold is theta_star = g0*gdepth*d*/I = 0.0633
corrections.fix: renamed key to alpha_cusp_g_star_marker; docstrings corrected; stale inline comment fixed
corrections.verified: crosschecks unchanged (closed-form residuals vs recorded values all <=0.0006)

corrections.correct_fact: the label '6' counts T=0.0501 vs G=0.05 as distinct at 4dp and adds the null 'axis' class - a rounding artifact; physical direction classes = 5 ({-0.1, 0.0, 2.05} core slopes/polar + axis, T~G merged)
corrections.fix: added robust clustering; new fields n_physical_direction_classes=5, physical_classes; verdict and identity corrected
corrections.verified: core slopes unchanged {0.0501, 2.0541, -0.1002}; credit-rail collinearity and scale_recursion=False unchanged

corrections.wrong_statement: '12 rays fold to 12/2 = 6 axes (split 12 -> scale 6 measured)' 'matches genesis_scale_measured_6_labels'
corrections.correct_fact: scale's '6' was a rounding artifact; physical classes = 5.  The Euler fold claim rests on the clock step pi/6, (e^(i*pi/6))^6 = -1, and |e^(i*pi)|^2=1 - not on the decimal 6
corrections.fix: identity, fold object, docstring, and print corrected; JSON regenerated
corrections.verified: numerics table unchanged (no pi/e/i magnitude match within 1% other than alpha~pi/3 at chance level)

corrections.correct_fact: 12 charge generators fold to 5 physical direction classes (3 core slopes, polar credit point, axis)
corrections.fix: row's measured text corrected; JSON regenerated
corrections.verified: exact doubling checks unchanged (residuals 0.0 within booked 4dp)

corrections.fix: corrected_mapping and print updated with correction parenthetical

corrections.verified: freeze gate 1.0001 and conservation residual -2.728e-12 unchanged

corrections.correct_fact: escape threshold h/X = 0.0633 = g0*gdepth*d*/I; alpha_cusp=1.0553 is the g-ladder marker (= d*/I)

corrections.verified: existing gauge values unchanged; test suite re-run green (see below)

corrections.wrong_statement: first-draft claim that over-provisioned grant_bias (gb >= d*) 're-opens the denial line and lets drawdown reach the catapult d*'
corrections.correct_fact: toy verification contradicts it: a depleted buyer under gb=0.5 vs 10 has essentially the same denials (11 vs 10) and stays near depth 0.92; grant is credit-not-scar so cannot catapult; grant only raises trust a little (0.247 vs 0.295 trust over 5 grants of 1.0 for gb 0.5 vs 20) - the fragility it enables is second-order and bounded by the same lever/ceiling.  The gb/d* ratio is a POSITION measure of the knob, not a reach to the cusp.
corrections.fix: withdrawal recorded in the JSON identity/withdrawal fields, script docstring CORRECTION note, prints corrected
corrections.verified: per-run denials 11 vs 10; depth 0.919 vs 0.922; trust_lift 0.2472 vs 0.2947 (seed 3, 5 grants)

standing_withdrawals_unchanged: genesis_relaxation.json: Yang-Mills-style spectral-mass-gap reading withdrawn (linear sector gapless); |lambda|=0.0883 is a rotation modulus, not a relaxation rate.
genesis_law.json: 'log-uniform (Jeffreys)' threat spectrum withdrawn (was a Jacobian bug); corrected density is Pareto-2 in the main band.
genesis_euler.json / genesis_tail.json: no pi/e/i numeric miracle claimed; alpha~pi/3 is a chance-level hit under 96 comparisons.
